Get list of treatment plans by client ID with optional activation logs.

Args:
    client_id: Optional client ID to filter treatment plans
    action_required: Filter for treatment plans requiring action
    client_clinical_status: Filter by client clinical status
    status: Filter by treatment plan status
    expand: Optional sub-resources to include in response
    with_activation_logs: Include full activation log history for each treatment plan

Returns:
    List of treatment plans with opti
